title: Inbox surfacing and aging nudges on the global dashboard
body: Completed global raw inbox surfacing and aging advisory nudges. The global dashboard now reports queued inbox count, oldest queued age, aging threshold, and aging count; JSON output includes a globalInbox payload with rows, policy, summary, and an advisory inbox.triage.aging gap when queued raw items exceed the threshold. The advisory gap projects through the directive registry as inbox.triage-aging and names the global raw triage command. Console/global board views now include queued raw inbox rows in the Inbox rail and expanded raw status counts. Validation: pnpm check passed; focused Vitest coverage passed for the global inbox dashboard directive fixture, global board inbox rail, console raw status handling, and enforcement-gap coverage. Commit checkpoint SHA: b73c9616.
